scientific.integrity: The closed forms are proved algebraically and independently replayed by a finite numerical verifier. Literature searches found no direct prior statement of the complete Schatten family, but equivalence under different matrix-approximation terminology remains a residual risk.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is two-dimensional and concerns Schatten distance from the identity over the full positive metric family; no higher-dimensional invariance is claimed.

title: All Schatten-\(p\) distances select one metric ray in the two-level quasi-Hermitian problem
